name: archscript
description: Plan and review software architecture as code — Claude edits the live diagram in ArchScript for Mac.
long_description:
ArchScript is an architecture-as-code tool for macOS. This extension connects Claude to the architectures open in ArchScript for Mac: Claude can read them, change them with structured edits (elements, relations, containers, properties), validate them against architecture rules, get the review score, render the diagram and export Mermaid, PlantUML, Markdown, JSON or Terraform. Every change appears live in the window and is one undo step.

Requires ArchScript for Mac with ArchScript Pro (14-day free trial). Turn on Settings → AI → Allow AI assistants and paste the access token shown there. Local only: the app's server listens on 127.0.0.1 and requires the token.
